findings.evidence: Basic.lean:308 `@[simp] theorem eval_perm_smul` and Basic.lean:98 `@[simp] theorem Atom.map_atom` give the composed tuple. The file's own proofs avoid the problem with `simp only [mem_predicateSet, coordinates_smul, …]` (e.g. line 186).
findings.fix: Remove `@[simp]` from `coordinates_apply` and keep it as a plain rewrite. Mark `coordinates_smul` `@[simp]`. Add a `@[simp]` `coordinates` form of `eval_coordinates_symm` if one is needed.
findings.issue: `@[simp] coordinates_apply` rewrites every `coordinates c v` (including the RHS of simp lemma `mem_predicateSet`) to `c.eval (atom Relation.pred fun _ => v)`, while `coordinates_smul` (line 93) has no `@[simp]`. Simp on `coordinates (σ • c) v` then stops at `atom pred (⇑σ.symm ∘ fun _ => v)`, a different term from what `coordinates_apply` produces.

findings.evidence: Local `have h (v : V) : v ∈ predicateSet c ↔ σ v ∈ predicateSet (σ • c)` in the forward direction of `isoSetoid_iff_cardinalities_eq`. No public statement of it exists in the file.
findings.fix: Add a `@[simp]` lemma `predicateSet_smul : predicateSet (σ • c) = σ '' predicateSet c`, or the `mem_` version, and a carrier-general `cardinalities_smul : cardinalities (σ • c) = cardinalities c`. Use both in the classifier proof.
findings.issue: `predicateSet` has no lemma for relabelling. The local `h` (`v ∈ predicateSet c ↔ σ v ∈ predicateSet (σ • c)`) is built inside the `isoSetoid_iff_cardinalities_eq` proof. So relabelling invariance of `cardinalities`, which holds on any carrier, is only available through that `[Countable V]` lemma.

summary: Simp is oriented against the `coordinates` view: `coordinates_apply` unfolds it to raw atom evaluation, and `coordinates_smul` is not simp. `predicateSet` also has no lemma for how relabelling moves it.
